tolerances.declaration_scope: full-corpus run; one prior exploratory French clip
tolerances.rationale: FP32 feature extraction; cross-backend reduction diagnostics for encoder/logits. Canonical Photon MPS runs fp16, so exact path/text gates are independent.

limitations: MLX reuses recorded original segment boundaries; its long-form segmentation is not evaluated.
Synthetic multilingual smoke is not representative language accuracy evaluation.
WER uses Unicode words; CER removes spaces. Empty references use denominator one.
Only exact parity is gated; no corpus-level accuracy threshold is asserted.
violations: quiet-pcm16/segment-0: features exceeds diagnostic tolerance or exact-match gate
quiet-pcm16/segment-0: subsampling exceeds diagnostic tolerance or exact-match gate
quiet-pcm16/segment-0: layer_0 exceeds diagnostic tolerance or exact-match gate
quiet-low/segment-0: features exceeds diagnostic tolerance or exact-match gate
